lead.headline: Millions watch Spain's first total solar eclipse since 1912
lead.dek: Totality ran about a minute over Spain under cloudless skies; much of Iceland was clouded over.
body: Millions of people across northern Spain, Portugal, Iceland and Greenland watched a total solar eclipse Wednesday evening, the first visible from mainland Spain since 1912. The moon's shadow crossed the North Atlantic and reached the Iberian Peninsula close to sunset, and cheers went up at viewing sites as the sun went out.

Totality lasted less than 2 1/2 minutes at its maximum, off Iceland's west coast, and about a minute by the time the shadow reached Spain and Portugal. Spain set up 350 official viewing areas and deployed about 33,500 officers, expecting at least a half-million extra visitors.
Skies were cloudless over Spain and Portugal, much of Iceland was overcast, and in Britain the sun was more than 90% obscured. Spain's next total eclipse falls Aug. 2, 2027.

briefs.headline: Inflation eases to 3.4%, still ahead of wages
briefs.summary: Consumer prices rose 0.1% in July and 3.4% over the year, down from 3.5%, against a 3.2% pace of wage growth. Gasoline fell 2.9%.

briefs.headline: Leavitt steps down as White House press secretary
briefs.summary: Trump announced the departure Wednesday. Leavitt, 28, cited the time her two young children need; no successor was named.

briefs.headline: 3 states set executions for the same day
briefs.summary: Tennessee, Alabama and Oklahoma each plan to put a prisoner to death Thursday, the first such convergence since Jan. 7, 2010.

briefs.headline: Colombia's quake toll reaches 265 as digging goes on
briefs.summary: President Abelardo de la Espriella gave the figure Wednesday evening; nearly 500 people are officially missing.

briefs.headline: US ambassador calls settler siege in Qusra an act of terror
briefs.summary: Settlers besieged Palestinian homes in the West Bank village from Sunday, cutting off food and water. Israeli troops evacuated two people Thursday.

briefs.headline: Putin visits a disputed Kuril island, drawing Japan's protest
briefs.summary: Putin toured Iturup on Thursday, his first trip to the chain. Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi called the visit "absolutely unacceptable."

briefs.headline: Carbon monoxide empties a Barbour County coal mine
briefs.summary: Monitors picked up high levels about 2:15 a.m. Wednesday at Allegheny Met's Longview Mine at Volga. All the miners got out.

briefs.headline: State test scores pass their pre-pandemic marks
briefs.summary: Math proficiency hit 39.4%, above 2019's 38.7%, and reading met or beat 2019. Science was flat and 11th-grade reading fell to 51%.

regional.item: Testing at the Peoples Cartage fire site found nothing above federal action levels, some above state screening levels.

fishing.line: 335 cfs and rising, gauge at 2.51 ft - pushy. Wadeable at the edges, not across.
Sound highs 9:12 a.m. and 9:42 p.m. at Hampstead, 3.7 and 4.4 feet.

briefs.headline: Malawi reach the Women's Africa Cup of Nations final
briefs.summary: Tabitha Chawinga scored twice in a 3-1 win over Algeria in Malawi's first WAFCON. Cameroon beat Morocco on penalties.

briefs.headline: Leon knock Inter Miami out of the Leagues Cup 3-2
briefs.summary: Daniel Arcila scored in the 50th and 83rd minutes. Messi came on at halftime, his first appearance since his father, Jorge, died Saturday at 68.

briefs.headline: Starlink orbits map the air 500 km up
briefs.summary: Kyoto University ran tomography on drag data from about 1,200 Starlink satellites to map thermosphere density, matching ESA's Swarm.

briefs.headline: Webb finds dust and ionized gas in the Lion Nebula
briefs.summary: Infrared images of NGC 2392 show dust and ionized gas around the white dwarf at its center, a shell due to disperse in about 10,000 years.
